column1: # Red Dead Redemption 1.0.7 (v458752). Made from the build's provisional profile, plus render_cond on: the game wraps draws in conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional),
# which the host drew anyway: the main menu came out scrambled, parts of its UI missing. Its archives' tables are decrypted with its own cipher (hle_rpf.c, DM_RPF_DECRYPT); shaders:
# shader_split.py rpf6_shaders / rgxd_records, plus 2 boot-screen shaders filled in at run time (<version>/nvn_capture). The second audio renderer is driven by the host (hle_audren.c)
